info.name: EUIT Firebase profiles and permissions — isolated regression
info.description: Run with npm run test:postman. Uses disposable Auth emulator + PostgreSQL fixtures. __tests routes exist only in the fixture harness. No production credentials.

exec: pm.test("Internal profile and verified login email", () => { pm.expect(body.data.id).to.equal(pm.environment.get('studentId')); pm.expect(body.data.email).to.equal('student@example.test'); pm.expect(body.data.emailVerified).to.equal(true); pm.expect(body.data.role).to.equal('STUDENT'); });

pm.test("No staff grants or internal identity fields", () => { pm.expect(body.data.permissions).not.to.include('access.write'); pm.expect(body.data).not.to.have.property('firebaseUid'); pm.expect(body.data.batchScope).to.deep.equal({mode:'ASSIGNED',batchIds:[]}); });

pm.test("Defaults before a preference record exists", () => { pm.expect(body.data.emailNotifications).to.equal(true); pm.expect(body.data.marketingEmails).to.equal(false); pm.expect(body.data.leaderboardVisible).to.equal(true); });
pm.test("Preferences are isolated by internal profile ID", () => { pm.expect(body.data.smsNotifications).to.equal(true); pm.expect(body.data.leaderboardVisible).to.equal(true); });

item.name: Student cannot read staff permission catalog

exec: pm.test("Six seeded system roles plus custom role", () => { pm.expect(body.data.filter(r => r.system).map(r => r.key)).to.have.members(['OWNER','ADMIN','ACCOUNTS','ADMISSIONS','MENTOR','STUDENT']); });
pm.test("Mentor fields accepted and skills normalized", () => { pm.expect(body.data.skills).to.deep.equal(['React','TypeScript']); pm.expect(body.data.yearsOfExperience).to.equal(6); });

item.name: Custom role without preference grant is denied
Same token observes new permissions immediately

exec: pm.test("No token refresh needed for application role changes", () => { pm.expect(body.data.role).to.equal('MENTOR'); pm.expect(body.data.permissions).to.include('teaching.write'); pm.expect(body.data.batchScope.batchIds).to.deep.equal([pm.environment.get('batchA')]); });
